checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BOOTSTRAP-RESP: Reject bootstrap responses with invalid sync committee aggregate signatures
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a LightClientBootstrap response with a valid structure but an invalid aggregate BLS signature (e.g., random bytes, signature from wrong committee, signature over wrong data). 2. Send this crafted response via the Req/Resp GetLightClientBootstrap protocol to the target client. 3. Verify the client discards the bootstrap and does not update its light client state. 4. Craft a response with a valid signature but from a previous sync committee period. 5. Verify rejection. 6. Confirm no partial state updates occurred (light client store unchanged).
executable_checks: Unit test: submit bootstrap with zeroed-out signature → expect rejection
Unit test: submit bootstrap with signature from wrong sync committee → expect rejection
Integration test: full P2P bootstrap flow with invalid sig → client state unchanged
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-PRECOND-005. Boundary edge EDGE-BOOTSTRAP-RESP from EXT-P2P-PEER-LC-REQRESP to CL via Req/Resp interface. Security assumption: must validate fork version, SSZ deserialization, and cryptographic proofs.

checklist.title: Verify bootstrap validation logic checks aggregate signature against current sync committee keys
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review the ACTION-VALIDATE-BOOTSTRAP code path to confirm it extracts participant bits and reconstructs the aggregate public key from the current sync committee. 2. Test with a bootstrap where participant count < 2/3 threshold. 3. Test with a bootstrap signed by a valid but outdated committee. 4. Verify the validation enforces the correct fork version for signature domain computation.
executable_checks: Unit test: bootstrap with insufficient participation bits → reject
Unit test: bootstrap signed under wrong fork version → reject
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-PRECOND-005. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-BOOTSTRAP.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS: Reject deposit snapshots with count exceeding finalized deposits
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Determine the current finalized deposit count from the beacon chain state. 2. Craft a deposit snapshot response via /eth/v1/beacon/deposit_snapshot with deposit_count = finalized_count + 1. 3. Send to the client and verify it is rejected. 4. Craft a snapshot with deposit_count = MAX_UINT64 and verify rejection. 5. Craft a valid snapshot (deposit_count <= finalized_count) and verify acceptance. 6. Verify the client recalculates the deposit root from finalized hashes and compares against transmitted deposit_root.
executable_checks: Unit test: snapshot with deposit_count > finalized_count → reject
Unit test: snapshot with deposit_count == finalized_count → accept if root matches
Unit test: snapshot with mismatched deposit_root → reject
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP4881-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS from EXT-BEACON-PEER-SNAPSHOT to CL via /eth/v1/beacon/deposit_snapshot. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP4881-01.

checklist.title: Verify deposit count comparison logic uses finalized beacon state as source of truth
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review ACTION-CHECK-DEPOSIT-COUNT to confirm it reads finalized deposit count from the beacon chain, not from a cached or stale value. 2. Test with a snapshot arriving during epoch transition to verify the finalized count is correctly updated. 3. Verify the comparison is <= (not <) to allow exact matches.
executable_checks: Unit test: snapshot with count == finalized count → accept
Unit test: snapshot arriving mid-finalization → uses latest finalized count
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP4881-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for ACTION-CHECK-DEPOSIT-COUNT.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-START-VALIDATION: Reject Cancun headers with non-zero difficulty or nonce
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a Cancun block header with difficulty = 1 and nonce = 0x0000000000000000. Send via P2P block propagation. Verify rejection. 2. Craft a header with difficulty = 0 and nonce = 0x0000000000000001. Verify rejection. 3. Craft a header with both non-zero. Verify rejection. 4. Craft a valid header with difficulty = 0 and nonce = 0x0000000000000000. Verify it passes this specific check. 5. Verify the validation occurs before any state modifications.
executable_checks: Unit test: header with difficulty=1, nonce=0 → reject
Unit test: header with difficulty=0, nonce=1 → reject
Unit test: header with difficulty=0, nonce=0 → passes post-merge check
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-PRECOND-004. Boundary edge EDGE-START-VALIDATION from EXT-NETWORK-PEER-BLOCKS to EL via P2P block header reception. Related ambiguity AMB-CANCUN-BLOCKS-02.

checklist.title: Verify header validation enforces post-merge fields before processing other Cancun-specific fields
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Review ACTION-VALIDATE-HEADER to confirm difficulty/nonce checks occur early in the validation pipeline. 2. Verify that a header failing post-merge checks does not trigger expensive blob gas or parent beacon root validations. 3. Test ordering by injecting a header that would pass blob checks but fail post-merge checks.

checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-HEADER.

checklist.title: Falsify hex decoding invariant: attempt to decode strings with invalid characters without triggering an error
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify all hex decoding functions in the codebase. 2. For each function, submit inputs containing: 'g' (just outside valid range), null bytes, unicode characters (e.g., fullwidth digits), whitespace within the hex string, mixed-case '0X' prefix. 3. Verify each invalid input raises ValueError or equivalent. 4. Verify that no function silently truncates at the first invalid character or substitutes zeros. 5. Test empty string and '0x' alone (edge cases).
executable_checks: Unit test: decode('0xZZ') → ValueError
Unit test: decode('abcg') → ValueError
Unit test: decode('0x') → empty bytes or ValueError (per spec)

checklist.title: Falsify Capella rule carry-forward invariant: find a Capella LC rule that is silently dropped in Deneb
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all Capella light client protocol rules (from spec). 2. For each rule, verify it is either explicitly superseded by a Deneb change or still enforced in the Deneb fork handler. 3. Focus on edge cases: timeout parameters, sync committee period boundaries, SSZ container changes. 4. Test by sending a Capella-era invalid message through the Deneb handler and verifying it is still rejected. 5. Check that the set of carried-forward rules is enumerable (documentation/code comments exist).

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-196 input trimming invariant: supply surplus bytes and verify they are ignored without failure
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. For bn256Add (0x06): expected input = 128 bytes. Supply 129, 256, 1024 bytes. Verify output matches the result for the first 128 bytes. 2. For bn256ScalarMul (0x07): expected input = 96 bytes. Supply 97, 256 bytes. Verify same. 3. For bn256Pairing (0x08): expected input = k*192 bytes. Supply k*192+1 bytes. Verify pairing result matches k pairs. 4. Verify no revert or gas penalty for surplus bytes. 5. Cross-client comparison: run same surplus-byte inputs on multiple clients, verify identical output.
executable_checks: Unit test: bn256Add with 129 bytes → same result as 128 bytes
Unit test: bn256ScalarMul with 200 bytes → same result as 96 bytes
Unit test: bn256Pairing with 193 bytes → same result as 192 bytes

checklist.title: Falsify memory zero-padding invariant: read beyond allocated memory and check for non-zero bytes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that writes non-zero data to memory offsets 0x00-0x1F. 2. Read from offset 0x20 with length 32 (beyond written region). 3. Verify all returned bytes are 0x00. 4. Repeat with CALLDATACOPY, RETURNDATACOPY, CODECOPY reading past their data into uninitialized memory. 5. Use MLOAD at offset just beyond allocation boundary. 6. Verify across different memory expansion scenarios (fresh context, after MSTORE, after MCOPY).
executable_checks: EVM test: MLOAD at offset beyond allocation → returns 0
EVM test: CALLDATACOPY with dest beyond allocation, then MLOAD → 0-padded
EVM test: fresh context MLOAD at offset 0 → 0

checklist.title: Falsify deposit tree snapshot consistency: trigger snapshot during active deposit processing and check for Merkle root inconsistency
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up a deposit tree with known state. 2. Begin a batch deposit insertion (multiple deposits). 3. During insertion (mid-batch), request a snapshot via the snapshot API. 4. Verify the snapshot either: (a) includes all deposits up to a consistent cutoff, or (b) is deferred until the batch completes. 5. Recompute the Merkle root from the snapshot's finalized hashes and compare to the snapshot's claimed root. 6. Test with concurrent snapshot requests.

Unit test: snapshot root matches recomputed root from finalized hashes
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP4881-INV-003. Invariant falsification targeting ACTION-TAKE-SNAPSHOT. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP4881-03.

checklist.title: Falsify genesis download retry invariant: simulate persistent download failures and verify client does not proceed with partial state
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Configure client for a testnet where genesis download endpoint is unreachable. 2. Observe retry behavior: verify exponential backoff pattern (delays increase). 3. After max retries, verify client halts with a clear error message (not a crash or silent failure). 4. Verify no partial genesis state is written to disk. 5. Test with intermittent failures (some retries succeed partially) and verify the client doesn't accept a truncated genesis state.
executable_checks: Integration test: unreachable genesis endpoint → client retries with backoff → halts with error
Unit test: partial genesis download response → rejected, retry triggered

checklist.title: Falsify hex untrusted-input invariant: pass unsanitized external hex through RPC/config paths and check for validation bypass
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify all code paths where hex strings enter from external sources (RPC parameters, config file fields). 2. For each entry point, submit: (a) hex with embedded null bytes, (b) hex with shell metacharacters, (c) extremely long hex strings (>1MB), (d) hex with Unicode lookalike characters. 3. Verify each is validated before reaching the hex utility functions. 4. Verify hex utility functions themselves also validate (defense in depth). 5. Check that error messages don't leak internal paths or state.
executable_checks: Unit test: RPC call with hex containing null bytes → validation error before decode
Unit test: config file with oversized hex value → rejected at config parse

checklist.title: Falsify Engine API JWT authentication invariant: send unauthenticated Engine API calls and verify rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Start an execution client with Engine API enabled and JWT secret configured. 2. Send engine_newPayloadV3 without any Authorization header. Verify HTTP 401 or equivalent rejection. 3. Send with an expired JWT token. Verify rejection. 4. Send with a JWT signed by a different secret. Verify rejection. 5. Send with a valid JWT but to a non-Engine API endpoint. Verify normal processing. 6. Verify the rejection occurs before any payload processing (no side effects).
executable_checks: Integration test: engine_newPayloadV3 without JWT → 401
Integration test: engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV3 with expired JWT → 401
Integration test: engine_newPayloadV3 with wrong-secret JWT → 401
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7928-INV-003. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-ENGINE-API-CHANNEL. Related assumption ASSUM-EIP7928-02.

checklist.title: Falsify EIP-196 gas calibration invariant: execute worst-case curve operations at gas limit and measure wall-clock time
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a transaction that fills the entire gas limit with bn256Pairing calls using maximum-length input. 2. Measure wall-clock execution time. 3. Verify execution completes within the block time (12 seconds for PoS Ethereum). 4. Repeat for bn256Add and bn256ScalarMul with gas-limit-filling transactions. 5. Compare across multiple client implementations to identify any with slower native implementations. 6. Test with adversarially chosen points that maximize computation time.
executable_checks: Benchmark: gas-limit of bn256Pairing calls → completes within block time
Benchmark: gas-limit of bn256ScalarMul calls → completes within block time
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP196-INV-005. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-GAS-COST-TABLE. Related assumption ASSUM-EIP196-02.

checklist.title: Falsify precompile address exclusivity invariant: attempt to deploy EVM bytecode at precompile addresses
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. For each precompile address (0x01-0x0a): attempt to deploy a contract via CREATE2 that would land at the precompile address. 2. Verify the deployment fails or the precompile behavior is not overridden. 3. CALL each precompile address and verify native implementation executes (not EVM bytecode). 4. Check EXTCODESIZE and EXTCODEHASH for precompile addresses return the expected values (0 codesize, empty codehash). 5. Verify SELFDESTRUCT from a precompile address is not possible.
executable_checks: EVM test: CREATE2 targeting precompile address → deployment fails or does not override
EVM test: CALL to 0x06 → bn256Add executes, not bytecode
EVM test: EXTCODESIZE(0x01) → 0

checklist.title: Falsify zero-initialization invariant: allocate new memory and read before writing to check for non-zero
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that: (a) expands memory by accessing a high offset via MSTORE at offset 0x1000, (b) immediately reads from offset 0x0800 (within newly allocated but unwritten range). 2. Verify all read bytes are zero. 3. Test after MSTORE8 at an offset — read adjacent unwritten bytes. 4. Test in a subcall context: allocate memory, return, allocate again in a new call — verify fresh zeros. 5. Test with MCOPY source in uninitialized region.
executable_checks: EVM test: expand memory, MLOAD from unwritten offset → 0
EVM test: MSTORE8 then MLOAD adjacent → upper bytes are 0
EVM test: new call context memory → all zeros
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-CANCUNMEM-INV-005. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-MEMORY-INITIALIZED. Related assumption ASSUM-CANCUN-MEM-02.

checklist.title: Falsify deposit event indexing invariant: inject out-of-order or missing deposit events and verify detection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set up a test chain with known deposit events at specific block numbers and log indices. 2. Remove one deposit event from the EL event log. 3. Verify the CL detects the discrepancy by comparing deposit count in beacon state vs events received. 4. Reorder two deposit events (swap log indices). 5. Verify detection. 6. Insert a duplicate deposit event. 7. Verify the system handles or detects the duplicate.

Integration test: reordered deposit events → detected and rejected
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP4881-INV-006. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-EVENT-INDEX. Related assumption ASSUM-EIP4881-03.

checklist.title: Falsify beacon block root integrity invariant: submit block with forged parent_beacon_block_root and verify rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a Cancun block with a valid header but a random parent_beacon_block_root (not matching any real beacon block). 2. Submit for validation. 3. Verify rejection during header validation. 4. Test with the parent_beacon_block_root of a non-parent beacon block (valid root but wrong slot). 5. Verify rejection. 6. Verify the beacon root ring buffer (EIP-4788) is correctly populated and queried.

Unit test: valid beacon root from wrong slot → rejected
Integration test: beacon root ring buffer query returns correct root for given timestamp
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-INV-005. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-BEACON-ROOT. Related assumption ASSUM-CANCUN-BLOCKS-03.

checklist.title: Falsify genesis parameter trust invariant: attempt to inject genesis parameters via P2P and verify rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify how clients load genesis parameters (config file, embedded, CLI flag). 2. Attempt to override genesis parameters by sending a crafted P2P message (e.g., Status message with different fork version, genesis_validators_root). 3. Verify the client does not adopt P2P-sourced genesis parameters. 4. Verify the client uses only the locally configured genesis. 5. Test with a fresh client joining the network — verify it requires pre-configured genesis and doesn't download it from untrusted peers.

Integration test: client without local genesis config → refuses to start

checklist.title: Falsify MSTORE8 byte masking invariant: pass large values and verify only LSB is written
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute MSTORE8 with value 0xFF00 at offset 0. Then MLOAD at offset 0 and check that only byte at position 0 is 0x00 (the LSB of 0xFF00). 2. Execute MSTORE8 with value 0x0102030405...FF (full 32-byte value) and verify only the last byte is written. 3. Verify adjacent memory bytes are not affected. 4. Test with value = 0 (edge case). 5. Test with value = 255 (maximum single byte).
executable_checks: EVM test: MSTORE8(0, 0xFF00) then MLOAD(0) → byte 0 is 0x00
EVM test: MSTORE8(0, 0x1FF) then MLOAD(0) → byte 0 is 0xFF
EVM test: MSTORE8 does not affect adjacent bytes
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EVMMEM-INV-006. Invariant falsification targeting ACTION-MSTORE8. Related assumption ASSUM-MEMORY-04.

checklist.title: Falsify precompile return data postcondition: verify return buffer and gas accounting after successful precompile call
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. CALL the ecRecover precompile (0x01) with a valid signature. 2. After return, use RETURNDATASIZE and RETURNDATACOPY to verify the return data matches expected output. 3. Check gas remaining equals initial gas minus precompile gas cost minus call overhead. 4. Test with STATICCALL and DELEGATECALL variants. 5. Test with a precompile that returns empty data on success (e.g., bn256Pairing returning 0x01 for valid pairing).
executable_checks: EVM test: CALL ecRecover → RETURNDATASIZE == 32, data == recovered address
EVM test: gas after precompile call == gas before - precompile_cost - call_overhead
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRECOMP-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification targeting ACTION-DISPATCH-PRECOMPILE.

checklist.title: Falsify snapshot loading postcondition: verify local tree state matches snapshot and new deposits can be appended
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Load a valid deposit snapshot. 2. Verify local deposit tree root matches snapshot's Merkle root. 3. Verify local deposit count matches snapshot's deposit count. 4. Append a new deposit to the tree. 5. Verify the resulting Merkle root is correct (matches independent computation). 6. Verify the deposit count incremented by 1. 7. Test loading a snapshot then immediately taking a new snapshot — verify round-trip consistency.
executable_checks: Unit test: load snapshot → local root matches snapshot root
Unit test: load snapshot → append deposit → root is correct
Unit test: load snapshot → take snapshot → identical output
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP4881-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition falsification targeting STATE-SNAPSHOT-LOADED.

checklist.title: Falsify blob_gas_used validation postcondition: submit headers with invalid blob gas values
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a block header with blob_gas_used = GAS_PER_BLOB - 1 (not a multiple). Verify rejection. 2. Craft with blob_gas_used = MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK + GAS_PER_BLOB. Verify rejection. 3. Craft with blob_gas_used = 0 (valid, zero blobs). Verify acceptance. 4. Craft with blob_gas_used = MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (valid, max blobs). Verify acceptance. 5. Verify the check occurs as part of header validation (postcondition of validation pipeline).
executable_checks: Unit test: blob_gas_used not multiple of 2^17 → reject
Unit test: blob_gas_used > MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK → reject
Unit test: blob_gas_used = 0 → accept
Unit test: blob_gas_used = MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK → accept
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-POSTCOND-004. Post-condition falsification targeting STATE-HEADER-VALID.

checklist.title: Falsify blob count match postcondition: submit block with mismatched blob count vs commitments
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block with 3 blob commitments in the header but only 2 actual blobs in the body. Verify rejection. 2. Construct with 2 commitments but 3 blobs. Verify rejection. 3. Construct with 0 commitments and 0 blobs. Verify acceptance. 4. Construct with matching counts (e.g., 3 and 3). Verify acceptance (assuming valid blob proofs). 5. Verify the count check happens during state transition, after blob verification.
executable_checks: Unit test: 3 commitments, 2 blobs → block rejected
Unit test: 2 commitments, 3 blobs → block rejected
Unit test: 3 commitments, 3 blobs (valid proofs) → accepted
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7928-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition falsification targeting STATE-BLOBS-VALIDATED.

checklist.title: Falsify MCOPY postcondition: verify byte-exact copy and correct memory expansion for overlapping ranges
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Write a known pattern to memory [0x00, 0x3F]. Execute MCOPY from src=0x00, dst=0x20, len=0x20 (overlapping forward). Verify [0x20,0x3F] contains original [0x00,0x1F]. 2. Execute MCOPY from src=0x20, dst=0x00, len=0x20 (overlapping backward). Verify correct copy. 3. Execute MCOPY to a destination beyond current memory size. Verify memory expands and MSIZE reflects new size. 4. Execute MCOPY with len=0. Verify no-op. 5. Verify gas cost accounts for memory expansion.
executable_checks: EVM test: overlapping MCOPY forward → correct result
EVM test: overlapping MCOPY backward → correct result
EVM test: MCOPY beyond memory → expansion + MSIZE updated
EVM test: MCOPY len=0 → no-op
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EVMMEM-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition falsification targeting ACTION-MCOPY.

checklist.title: Falsify optimistic update postcondition: submit update with slot < current optimistic header slot
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Apply a valid LightClientOptimisticUpdate for slot N. 2. Apply another valid update for slot N-1. Verify the optimistic header slot remains N (update rejected or ignored). 3. Apply update for slot N (same slot). Verify behavior (should be accepted or no-op). 4. Apply update for slot N+1. Verify optimistic header advances to N+1. 5. Verify signature is checked before slot comparison (not after).
executable_checks: Unit test: optimistic update slot < current → rejected/ignored
Unit test: optimistic update slot == current → accepted or no-op
Unit test: optimistic update with invalid sig but higher slot → rejected (sig checked first)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition falsification targeting STATE-OPTIMISTIC-HEADER.

checklist.title: Falsify precompile gas precondition: call precompile with exactly base_cost-1 gas and verify failure without execution
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. For ecRecover (0x01, base cost = 3000): CALL with gas = 2999. Verify the call returns failure. Verify no return data (precompile did not execute). 2. Verify gas consumed is only the call overhead, not the full precompile cost. 3. Repeat for each precompile with its specific base cost. 4. Test with gas = base_cost exactly. Verify success for precompiles with no dynamic gas component. 5. For bn256Pairing with dynamic cost: test with gas = base + per_pair * (k-1) (one pair short).

EVM test: CALL ecRecover with gas=3000 → success
EVM test: CALL bn256Pairing with insufficient gas for k pairs → failure
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRECOMP-PRECOND-001. Pre-condition falsification targeting ACTION-CHECK-PRECOMPILE-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify transaction trie root postcondition: execute block with tampered transaction and verify root mismatch detection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a valid Cancun block. Modify one transaction (e.g., change a value field by 1 wei). 2. Submit the block without updating the transactions_root. 3. Verify the block is rejected due to root mismatch. 4. Verify the rejection occurs after transaction execution (postcondition of apply-body). 5. Test with an empty block (zero transactions) — verify the root matches the empty trie hash. 6. Test with a block containing the maximum number of transactions.

Unit test: empty block → transactions_root == empty trie hash
Unit test: valid block → computed root matches header root

checklist.title: Falsify precompile determinism invariant: run identical inputs across multiple client implementations and compare outputs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Prepare a test vector set covering all precompiles (0x01-0x0a) with: zero inputs, maximum-length inputs, edge-case inputs (points at infinity, identity elements). 2. Execute each test vector on at least 2 client implementations (e.g., geth, nethermind, besu, erigon). 3. Compare output bytes exactly. 4. Include gas consumption in comparison. 5. Test with inputs that trigger error paths (invalid curve points, failed signature recovery) — verify error behavior is also deterministic (same gas consumed, same empty return).

Cross-client test: bn256Pairing same input → byte-identical output on all clients
Cross-client test: invalid input to each precompile → same error behavior
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRECOMP-INV-007. Invariant falsification targeting STATE-PRECOMPILE-DETERMINISM.

checklist.title: Falsify sync committee participation threshold invariant: submit update with exactly 2/3 and below 2/3 participation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a LightClientUpdate with exactly 341/512 participation bits set (66.6%, just below 2/3). Verify rejection. 2. Construct with 342/512 (66.8%, at 2/3 threshold). Verify acceptance or rejection depending on whether threshold is strict > or >=. 3. Construct with 0/512. Verify rejection. 4. Construct with 512/512 (full participation). Verify acceptance. 5. Verify the participation check uses integer arithmetic correctly (no floating-point rounding issues).
executable_checks: Unit test: 341/512 participation → rejected
Unit test: 342/512 participation → check threshold behavior (>2/3 strict)
Unit test: 512/512 participation → accepted
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-INV-005. Invariant falsification targeting ACTION-CHECK-PARTICIPATION.

checklist.title: Falsify MSIZE monotonicity invariant: perform memory operations and verify MSIZE never decreases
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute MSIZE before any memory access. Verify returns 0. 2. MSTORE at offset 0. Execute MSIZE. Verify returns 32. 3. MLOAD at offset 64. Execute MSIZE. Verify returns 96 (rounded up to 32-byte boundary). 4. MSTORE at offset 0 (lower than previous max). Execute MSIZE. Verify still returns 96 (non-decreasing). 5. In a CALL context, verify MSIZE resets (new context) and is independent of parent. 6. Test MSIZE after MCOPY that doesn't extend memory.
executable_checks: EVM test: MSIZE before any access → 0
EVM test: MSTORE(0), MSIZE → 32
EVM test: MLOAD(64), MSIZE → 96
EVM test: MSTORE(0) again, MSIZE → still 96 (non-decreasing)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EVMMEM-INV-007. Invariant falsification targeting ACTION-MSIZE.
